title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 27, 2026 — Qalibaf Details His Meeting with the Supreme Leader
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 27, 2026 — Qalibaf Details His Meeting with the Supreme Leader"

"Iran’s Parliament Speaker, at today’s plenary session:"

"🔹 One of the issues usually asked about is the health of the Supreme Leader. In this regard, I state that he enjoys full health. What was very prominent and impactful for me in this meeting was his strong, lively, and hopeful spirit, alongside his firmness and inner calm."

"🔹 When the Leader was sitting and speaking, these qualities were clearly felt in him. I had already been closely acquainted with him, but what I observed in this meeting was, for me too, among the outstanding and noteworthy aspects of his personality."

"🔹 In addition, his mastery and command of issues, both in generalities and in details, was very impressive. I had known of this mastery before, but in this meeting I saw it tangibly. In this meeting, I felt with all my being that the Leader’s firmness and inner calm are rooted in strong faith in God Almighty and deep belief in the people."

"🔹 During the meeting, various issues were discussed. One important focus was the country’s economic issues. The Leader was closely following macroeconomic indicators and emphasized the need for careful attention to them."

"🔹 For those active in the economic field, it is clear that correct assessment of macroeconomic indicators is very important. In this regard, he specifically emphasized the need to avoid overestimating or underestimating reality."

"🔹 Another important issue was securing production chains. This was the third time during the Ramadan war that he seriously followed up this issue with me. This follow-up concerned both the supply of raw materials and the continuity of the production cycle and the supply of essential goods."

"🔹 In this framework, preserving people’s purchasing power and paying attention to their livelihoods was especially important. In particular, emphasis was placed on the need to pay attention to the livelihoods of the armed forces and the combatants present on the front lines."
